about.title: About
about.h1: Thirty years training the orbit of West African insurance.
about.directorQuote: In putting this site online, we hope to have set a new milestone in our development process, namely to promote insurance training on a large scale.
about.directorLetter1: Managing information and making it available to the public is, for CPFA, a strategic focus of development in the medium and long term. And the Internet is a fundamental tool for it.
about.directorLetter2: This site is therefore intended, above all, as a means of permanent, real-time communication between the training professionals that we are and all the other players in insurance (insurance companies, professional associations, trainers, students, and so on).
about.directorLetter3: Through this site you can not only learn about our programmes, but also take an active part in the process of creating and improving them — through your contributions and, above all, through the expression of your needs.
about.directorLetter4: We shall therefore spare no effort to give a comprehensive answer to your training concerns, in keeping with your vision and your strategic development objectives.
about.directorLetter5: As every human undertaking can be improved, we will take account of all your criticism and suggestions in order to enhance the quality of this information tool par excellence.
about.directorLetter6: We wish you a pleasant visit to this site and remain, Ladies and Gentlemen, yours faithfully.
about.directorRole: Director of CPFA · A decentralised unit of IIA Yaoundé
about.directorPhotoAlt: El Hadji Cheikhou Oumar SECK, Director of CPFA
about.intro1: Founded in 1996 through the joint initiative of the Ministry of Finance and the Senegalese Federation of Insurance Companies, CPFA has become, in three decades, the regional academic reference for technical and managerial careers in insurance.
about.intro2: More than 4,200 graduates work today across the CIMA zone — in insurance companies, at the Insurance Authority, in brokerage firms, and in pan-African institutions such as CICA-Re and Africa-Re.
